parameters.name: message

parameters.query:
=SELECT *
FROM meli_leads
WHERE (
  RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(buyer_phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = RIGHT('{{ String($json.number || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') }}', 8)
  {{ $json.meli_publicacion_id ? "AND item_id = '" + String($json.meli_publicacion_id).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '') + "'" : '' }}
)
-- El cliente puede escribir por WhatsApp desde otro numero que el de MercadoLibre:
-- si no coincide el telefono, la consulta de esa publicacion de las ultimas 24 h, solo si hay una sola.
OR (
  item_id = '{{ String($json.meli_publicacion_id || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '') }}' AND item_id <> ''
  AND received_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meli_leads m2
       WHERE m2.item_id = '{{ String($json.meli_publicacion_id || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '') }}'
         AND m2.received_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) = 1
)
ORDER BY (RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(buyer_phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = RIGHT('{{ String($json.number || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') }}', 8)) DESC, received_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT * FROM meli_asesores
WHERE (
  user_id = {{ Number($json.user_id) || 0 }}
  OR user_id = 2910875794
)
AND (
  RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(telefono, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = RIGHT('{{ String($json.asesor_phone || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') || 'x' }}', 8)
  OR RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(telefono, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = RIGHT('{{ String($json.asesor_phone2 || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') || 'x' }}', 8)
)
ORDER BY (user_id = 2910875794) DESC
LIMIT 1
